artboards.title: Option B — stated in the subline

annotations.text:
Pickup-only disclosure + Uber Eats link, /order hero.

Both use the site's real tokens: Cormorant Garamond + Jost, rose #C85478, blush #E8A4B5, and the existing .hero-proof chip surface. Nothing new invented.

A keeps the selling subline and states the constraint as a qualifier under the buttons. B moves it into the subline where it is read first, and costs that line of copy.

Uber Eats is a text link in both, never a button — it is a 25-35% commission channel.
